quote.text: The Last Hour would not come before the Euphrates uncovers a mountain of gold, for which people would fight.

shots.framing: HOOK. Wide: night; a sea of thousands of lamps and torches covering a mountain of gold rising from the riverbed; in the foreground a man (30s, sweat, torn shirt) grips a shovel, breathing hard
shots.camera: Slow push-in past the man toward the gold
shots.vo_markup: Ninety-nine out of every hundred will *die* for it.
shots.vo: Ninety-nine out of every hundred will die for it.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The sea of lights on the gold, the man's grip
shots.notes: Alive from frame 0 (lamps flicker, his chest heaving). Grip tightens on "die".

shots.framing: Close: the same man's face (simple), gold light reflected in his eyes; he swallows, then a small determined smile
shots.vo_markup: And every one of them believes he'll be the one who *survives.*
shots.vo: And every one of them believes he'll be the one who survives.
shots.speaker: narr

shots.framing: Wide: dusty roads converging on the river; trucks overloaded with people, a donkey cart, a family walking with shovels on their shoulders, a grandmother carried on a chair
shots.vo_markup: They came from every direction. Trucks, carts, whole families carrying *shovels.*
shots.vo: They came from every direction. Trucks, carts, whole families carrying shovels.
shots.speaker: narr

shots.framing: Medium: two men (one tall in a cap, one stocky with a beard) digging side by side in a pit of gold-flecked mud; the tall one passes a water bottle and they both laugh
shots.vo_markup: Two friends from the same street dug side by side. On the first day, they shared their *water.*
shots.vo: Two friends from the same street dug side by side. On the first day, they shared their water.
shots.speaker: narr

shots.framing: Medium: the same two men, a rope pegged tight on the ground between them; each digs only on his side, glancing at the other
shots.vo_markup: On the second day, they marked their ground with *rope.*
shots.vo: On the second day, they marked their ground with rope.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The rope between them, suspicious glances
shots.notes: The peg is hammered in on "rope".

shots.framing: Wide: dawn; one man (the stocky one) walks up the bank alone, carrying TWO shovels over his shoulder, not looking back; the pit behind him empty
shots.vo_markup: On the third day, only one of them came *back.*
shots.vo: On the third day, only one of them came back.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: Implied only: no body, no blood. He reaches the top on "back".

shots.framing: Medium: inside a tent camp; a father and his grown son each with one hand on the same small gold block on a blanket, neither letting go, staring at each other
shots.vo_markup: Fathers stopped trusting their sons. Brothers stopped *speaking.*
shots.vo: Fathers stopped trusting their sons. Brothers stopped speaking.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: Neither moves; the son's jaw tightens on "speaking".

shots.framing: Extreme wide: lines of generic armed men in plain uniforms (no flags, no insignia) in trucks fence the gold; on the far side two lines clash in dust and distant flashes (silhouettes only)
shots.vo_markup: Then the soldiers came to guard the gold. And the soldiers fought each *other.*
shots.vo: Then the soldiers came to guard the gold. And the soldiers fought each other.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: No gore, no bodies; flash on "other".

shots.framing: Wide: the tent camp at night; lanterns go out one by one; an empty tent flap moves in the wind
shots.vo_markup: Every night, the camp grew a little *quieter.*
shots.vo: Every night, the camp grew a little quieter.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: Last lantern in the row dies on "quieter".

shots.framing: Medium-low: dawn; a row of pairs of sandals outside empty tents, shovels stuck in the sand; a thin dog sniffs the sandals
shots.vo_markup: Sandals left at tent doors. Shovels no one came back *for.*
shots.vo: Sandals left at tent doors. Shovels no one came back for.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: Implied loss only. Dog lifts its head on "for".

shots.framing: Extreme wide: the mountain of gold glowing at dusk-dawn, smoke drifting across it, tiny figures scattered on the slopes
shots.vo_markup: Fourteen centuries ago, the Prophet said people would fight over it. And ninety-nine of every hundred would be *killed.*
shots.vo: Fourteen centuries ago, the Prophet said people would fight over it. And ninety-nine of every hundred would be killed.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: QUOTE overlay on this shot: keep the top ~15–40% dark and calm.

shots.framing: Close: a trembling hand clutching a lump of gold against a chest; the eyes above it dart left and right
shots.vo_markup: Each one hoping... to be the one who *lived.*
shots.vo: Each one hoping... to be the one who lived.
shots.speaker: narr

shots.framing: Wide: dawn; the gold mountain untouched and silent, abandoned shovels standing in the sand like markers, no people
shots.vo_markup: When the dust settled, the gold was still there. It didn't care who *owned* it.
shots.vo: When the dust settled, the gold was still there. It didn't care who owned it.
shots.speaker: narr

shots.framing: Medium-wide: a quiet old city street at night; a man seen ONLY FROM BEHIND (no face), backlit by a doorway, hands out cloth sacks to a long line of poor people, scooping by the handful
shots.vo_markup: And far from the river, in a city no one was watching, a man was giving wealth away... without even *counting* it.
shots.vo: And far from the river, in a city no one was watching, a man was giving wealth away... without even counting it.
shots.speaker: narr

shots.framing: Medium: two people in the line (an old woman and a young man) lean together whispering, glancing back toward the backlit doorway
shots.vo_markup: And people had started to whisper a *name.*
shots.vo: And people had started to whisper a name.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: CLIFFHANGER: heartbeat. The young man's eyes widen on "name".

shots.framing: TITLE CARD: "NINETY-NINE" + "CHAPTER 7 · THE LAST DAYS" over dark smoke with a faint gold glow
shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: Deep bass drop on the cut.
